summaries.title: Rethinking Attention: Exploring Shallow Feed-Forward Neural Networks as an Alternative to Attention Layers in Transformers
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**模型架构与序列建模**（Architecture）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Rethinking Attention** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖模型架构与序列建模（Architecture）。核心论点主张：We substitute key elements of the attention mechanism in the Transformer with simple feed-forward networks, trained using the original components via knowledge distillation。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用师生知识蒸馏与能力迁移、受控干预消融与多范式系统对比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Our experiments, conducted on the IWSLT2017 dataset, reveal the capacity of these "attentionless Transformers" to rival the performance of the original architecture。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（This work presents an analysis of the effectiveness of using standard shallow feed-forward networks to mimic the behavior of the attention mechanism in the original Transformer model,...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 25 赞），本工作为突破 **合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: I&S-ViT: An Inclusive & Stable Method for Pushing the Limit of Post-Training ViTs Quantization
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **I&S-ViT** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖训练后量化（Post-Training Quantization (PTQ)），并引入 Post-training quantization (PTQ), novel shift-uniform-log2
quantizer (SULQ), three-stage smooth optimization strategy (SOS) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：In this paper, we introduce I&S-ViT, a novel method that regulates the PTQ of ViTs in an inclusive and stable fashion。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用分阶段渐进式训练/建模流水线、底层算子融合、量化压缩与执行流加速。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Post-training quantization (PTQ), tuning ViTs with a tiny dataset and running in a low-bit format, well addresses the cost issue but unluckily bears more...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **50.68%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（For instance, I&S-ViT elevates the performance of 3-bit ViT-B by an impressive 50.68%）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 9 赞），本工作为突破 **训练与强化学习** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
